article.headline: Longwood wins 80-54 over South Carolina Upstate
article.description: — Michael Christmas had 17 points in Longwood's 80-54 victory over South Carolina Upstate on Saturday.
article.linkText: Longwood wins 80-54 over South Carolina Upstate

categories.description: South Carolina Upstate Spartans @ Longwood Lancers

event.description: South Carolina Upstate Spartans @ Longwood Lancers

keywords: South Carolina Upstate Spartans @ Longwood Lancers
article.story: FARMVILLE, Va. -- — Michael Christmas had 17 points in Longwood's 80-54 victory over South Carolina Upstate on Saturday. Christmas shot 6 for 12 (3 for 8 from 3-point range) and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Lancers (16-6, 5-2 Big South Conference). Kyrell Luc scored 15 points while shooting 4 of 5 from the field and 6 for 7 from the line and added four steals. Colby Garland had 12 points and finished 4 of 6 from the field. The Spartans (5-17, 1-6) were led by Andrew McConnell, who posted 12 points, six rebounds and two steals. Karmani Gregory added 11 points for South Carolina Upstate. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
